reddit_quotes: I've used Alden Indy for 23 months. The build quality is evident the moment you hold it.
Alden Indy is the kind of thing you don't appreciate until you've used the cheap alternative and regretted it.
The Alden Indy community is split, but the people who actually own them tend to keep them.
detractor_quote: I returned my Alden Indy after two weeks. The marketing is better than the product.
